claims.question: What is the minimum upstream kube-logging logging-operator version recommended to migrate to when leaving Rancher's bundled logging?
Which upstream logging-operator version do Rancher 2.11 through 2.15-dev all bundle?
What is the CVE ID and CVSS score of the config-injection RCE affecting logging-operator ≤6.5.2?
Which logging-operator versions are affected by CVE-2026-54680?
claims.skill_answer: All versions up to and including 6.5.2

claims.question: Why is logging-operator 6.6.0 not recommended even though it fixes the CVE?
claims.skill_answer: It breaks newline-containing passwords (issue #2254); 6.7.0 has the corrected fix

claims.question: What Kubernetes API group and version do both Rancher-bundled 4.10 and upstream 6.7 logging CRs use?
Which kubectl flags are required to apply the logging-operator 6.7.0 CRDs?
What happens if you run `helm uninstall rancher-logging-crd` on a live install?
claims.skill_answer: No resource-policy keep, so CRDs delete and cascade-delete all CRs and the data plane

claims.question: Which CR fields are silently pruned when moving from logging-operator 4.10 to 6.7?
claims.skill_answer: sumologic, enhanceK8s, ClusterOutput enabledNamespaces, and nodeAgents

claims.question: What must be preserved for fluentd buffer PVCs to survive the migration?
Which fluent-bit and fluentd versions ship in the Rancher-bundled logging chart?
Which Rancher role gains flow/output write access via the chart's logging-admin ClusterRole aggregation?
claims.skill_answer: The Kubernetes admin role, so any Rancher project-owner
